description: This file defines the Vtiger_MailScanner class responsible for scanning mailboxes, applying rules to emails, and marking them as processed within the vtiger CRM system. It includes methods for connecting to mailboxes, searching emails, applying rules, and performing lookup operations for contacts, accounts, and tickets.

classes.name: Vtiger_MailScanner
classes.description: Provides functionality for scanning mailboxes according to configured rules, handling email processing, lookups, and logging, within the vtiger CRM email management module.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages either to a global logger or outputs directly if debugging is enabled.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MailScanner with scanner info and configuration.

methods.name: getMailBox
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the mailbox instance for scanning.

methods.name: performScanNow
methods.description: Initiates the mailbox scanning process, applies rules to new emails, and marks them as processed.

methods.name: applyRule
methods.description: Applies a specific rule to a mail record, fetching its body if necessary, and executes actions based on matches.

methods.name: markMessageScanned
methods.description: Inserts a record indicating that a message has been processed.

methods.name: isMessageScanned
methods.description: Checks whether a message has already been processed.

methods.name: updateLastscan
methods.description: Updates the last scan timestamp for a folder.

methods.name: __toInteger
methods.description: Converts a string to an integer if possible; returns false if invalid.

methods.name: LookupContact
methods.description: Finds a contact record by email, utilizing cache for efficiency.

methods.name: LookupAccount
methods.description: Finds an account record by email, utilizing cache for efficiency.

methods.name: LookupTicket
methods.description: Finds a ticket record by its ID or subject, utilizing cache.

methods.name: GetAccountRecord
methods.description: Retrieves the Account entity object for a given email.

methods.name: GetContactRecord
methods.description: Retrieves the Contact entity object for a given email.

methods.name: LookupContactOrAccount
methods.description: Attempts to find a contact, then an account based on email matching a specific CRM ID if provided.

methods.name: GetTicketRecord
methods.description: Retrieves the Ticket entity object for a given subject or ID, with optional email validation.
